key_logic.D-001: Three independent demo loops: job distance, profile/resume, and daily/weekly work reports.
key_logic.D-002: Exact address and home coordinates stay local; rotating nearby landmarks are used externally.
key_logic.D-003: Job discovery cannot directly modify the personal profile or resume.
key_logic.D-004: Scheduled public reads and limited local writes are allowed; external writes require confirmation.
key_logic.D-005: Root goal.md is authoritative; goal/ technical documents are subordinate and cannot change intent.
key_logic.D-006: Selected stack: pinned FastAPI template, LangGraph OSS, React/TypeScript, PostgreSQL, APScheduler worker, Docker Compose.
key_logic.D-007: Remote AI enters only through a local policy-controlled ModelProvider gateway.
key_logic.D-008: Upstream code is pinned and selectively imported without upstream Git or agent instructions.
key_logic.D-009: Bootstrap uses explicit Git boundaries and no public push, real personal data, or secrets without confirmation.
key_logic.D-010: LangGraph runs locally with PostgreSQL checkpoints and no required LangGraph cloud service.
key_logic.D-011: A network-free deterministic demo mode is separate from explicitly enabled live integrations.
